canonical_title: Google expands Lyria 3.5 to Gemini app and Gemini API
treatment: Do not repeat without a material availability, pricing, API, benchmark, or product change.
known_facts: The hard delta is wider availability rather than the first existence of Lyria 3.5.
Google made Lyria 3.5 available in the Gemini app, Gemini API, and Google AI Studio.
Gemini app users can select genre, vocal or instrumental styles, templates, and short or longer tracks.
reinclude_only_if: Material API pricing or model ID change.
Independent reproducible evaluation materially changes interpretation.
notes: Official post is dated Sep 4, 2026; timestamped coverage at 2:21 PM ET places the expansion inside this run window.
